entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SqliteCommand falsely reports bound prefix-less parameters as unbound when another parameter is missing #39370
    12.0.0
  • GroupBy element projection evaluates a conversion around `g.Key` on the client instead of as a SQL `CAST` #39367
    12.0-preview1
  • Query never returns (infinite loop on the client) when grouping by a value-converted reference type and projecting the group's elements #39366
    12.0-preview1
  • Allow providers to customize aggregate lowering of grouped Any/All #39363
    Backlog

Closed

  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: disposing a SqliteCommand closes its open SqliteDataReader #39336
    12.0-preview1
  • Parameter_collection_Concat_column_collection fails with latest SQLite #32561
    12.0-preview1
  • Scaffold-DbContext can name namespace wrong if phrase with space is used on OutputDir #24607
    12.0-preview1
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: SqliteParameter.Size = 0 sends an empty string or blob #39376
    12.0-preview1
  • No items when projecting out groupings with a null key #32026
    12.0-preview1
  • SQLite: JSON property names that need quoting translate to a ->> path that never matches #39328
    12.0-preview1
  • Invalid translation for constant negative TimeSpan for SQL Server #39222
    12.0-preview1
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: GetValues rejects an array shorter than the row, unlike the IDataRecord contract #39352
    12.0-preview1
  • Adding .ConfigureAwait() to async query causes precompiled query generation to fail #37961
    12.0-preview1
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: GetOrdinal throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for an unknown name, unlike the IDataRecord contract #39343
    12.0-preview1
  • Sealed entity types lead to error and warning when trying to cast to IInjectableService in precompiled queries #37957
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Don't hide lazy loading failures behind the IsLoaded exception #39387
    community-contribution
  • Keep local view bindings when the change tracker is cleared #39385
    community-contribution
  • Bump ip-address to 10.7.4 #39379
  • [release/10.0]: Bump SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3 from 2.1.13 to 2.1.14 #39374
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0]: Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.4.0 to 2.6.1 #39373
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.19.1 to 1.20.0 #39372
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix unbound parameter reporting for prefix-less and positional parameters #39371
    community-contribution
  • Compare converted reference-type identifiers by their provider values #39369
    community-contribution
  • Keep conversions around a grouping key on the server #39368
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39389
  • Keep a SqliteDataReader usable after its command is disposed #39337
    community-contribution
  • Drop invalid characters from namespaces built from output folder names #39386
    community-contribution
  • Don't truncate SqliteParameter values when Size is 0 #39377
    community-contribution
  • Delimit named default constraints in SqlServerMigrationsSqlGenerator #39384
    community-contribution
  • Read schema metadata for TEMP and attached tables in SqliteDataReaderGetSchemaTable #39383
    community-contribution
  • Translate DateTime.Millisecond on SQLite without floating-point trunation #39382
    community-contribution
  • Keep unnamed bits when generating [Flags] enum literals in CSharpHelper #39381
    community-contribution
  • Keep matching null keys when a correlated Where becomes a join #39365
    community-contribution
  • Use a JSONPATH for quoted JSON property names on SQLite #39378
    community-contribution
  • Throw for out-of-range SQL Server TimeSpan literals #39364
    community-contribution
  • Copy only what fits in SqliteDataReader.GetValues #39354
    community-contribution
  • Fix precompiled queries for sealed entity types #39326
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Fix precompiled queries that are the receiver of an instance method call #39331
    community-contribution
  • Throw IndexOutOfRangeException from SqliteDataReader.GetOrdinal for an unknown name #39353
    community-contribution

Updated

  • [release/9.0]: Bump SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3 from 2.1.13 to 2.1.14 #39357
    area-infrastructure
  • Lift GroupBy aggregates over navigations reached through an element s… #38960
    community-contribution
  • Add experimental ExecuteMerge / upsert support #39100
    community-contribution
  • Update tests for Azure SQL #39360
  • Preserve implicit conversions during query precompilation #39313
    area-harness
  • Add Array.IndexOf translation for byte arrays in SQL Server and SQLite #39203
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #39257
  • Fix collection Contains normalization element type and overload matching (#39329) #39359
    community-contribution
  • Make parameter collection projections that cannot be materialized untranslatable so they get client eval #39349
    community-contribution
  • Cosmos datetime fixed width #39131
    community-contribution
  • Fix misleading exception messages when obtaining DbSet with entity type name (#31565) #39342
    community-contribution
